/ ABOUT OLYMPIC CAFE

Your local cafe in Waltham Cross

Olympic Cafe is a warm, welcoming neighbourhood cafe on the High Street, serving British cafe classics, Mediterranean-inspired breakfasts and familiar family favourites.

British roots

Full English breakfasts, Sunday roasts, shepherd's pie and proper cafe favourites.

Mediterranean character

Halloumi, feta, olives and sucuk run through our breakfasts and brunch menu.

What to expect

Cafe favourites

Set breakfasts, brunch, lunches, burgers, sandwiches, jacket potatoes and hot and cold drinks.

Eat in or take away

Grab a table or call ahead for takeaway.

Open seven days a week

From early morning, Monday to Sunday. See our opening hours below.
